horoscopes.aries: Today with the Moon in Scorpio, Aries, you may feel intense emotions and a strong desire for transformation. This is a great day to dive deep into your passions and desires, and to confront any fears or insecurities that may be holding you back. You have the power to rebirth yourself and your circumstances. To harness this energy, take a few moments to sit in stillness and focus on your breath. Light a candle and repeat the mantra "Om Namaha Shivaya" to ignite your inner fire and guide you towards positive change.
horoscopes.taurus: Today, with the Moon in Scorpio, emotions may run deep for you, Taurus. You may feel a strong connection to your intuition and a desire to penetrate to the heart of any matter. Trust your instincts and don't be afraid to explore the unknown. This is a powerful time for transformation and renewal. To make the most of this energy, take a few moments to meditate and focus on your breath. Offer a simple prayer to your inner self, asking for guidance and clarity. Repeat the mantra "Om Shanti" to calm your mind and connect with your inner wisdom. May Neem Karoli Baba's blessings be with you.

A simple remedy to calm your mind is to light a candle and recite the mantra "Om Shri Hanumate Namaha" to invoke the wisdom and protection of Lord Hanuman. This will help you stay grounded and centered, even as the Scorpio Moon stirs your emotional waters.
